title: The Commission
text: I have given the Grace's master his commission in my own hand: to carry the Lady Livia and whoever she brings wherever she says, and to answer no other order. Not the Admiralty's. Not a Voice's. Not mine, after.
note: Framed in Hesk's great cabin, beside his own letter of marque. He thought it made his look older.
where: The Gull Isles, the great cabin
